rows.en:
Ever since Takeshi Hongo escaped… our Shocker has suffered one blunder after another! So…

we will join forces with this DARK and Makuu and sweep away the maggots, starting with Kamen Rider!!

To that end… DARK or Makuu, either will do! We can decide what to do with the other organizations afterward. Heh heh heh…
As you command… Truly, my Leader, you know every evil there is to know.

Mm, however… there's no telling how far those people can be trusted.

As Colonel Zol's successor, I have summoned a new executive from the Southeast Asia Branch. You have no objection, I trust?
What did you say!? The Southeast Asia Branch?

You have come a long way from Shocker's Southeast Asia Branch…

Ambassador Hell! I have high expectations for your actions…

Leader! I, Ambassador Hell, who ran rampant across Southeast Asia…

Now that I have been chosen and come to Japan, I will defeat Kamen Rider without fail!

With Ambassador Hell going to the trouble of coming all the way from Southeast Asia to Japan, I'd like to call it an unbeatable combination, but…

does it mean that I, Doctor Death, am not strong enough to conquer Japan alone?

Doctor Death, Ambassador Hell!

Spider Man, Bat Man, Scorpion Man, Bee Woman… Every one of these cyborgs was defeated by Kamen Rider.

So our Shocker ran these cyborgs through the computer, selected only their strengths, and modified this: Gebacondor!

Send in Gebacondor and slaughter Kamen Rider and his allies, every last one!

Doctor Death… As a little welcome gift, leave this to me, Ambassador Hell, first!

I'll round up Kamen Rider and his allies in one fell swoop! Ha ha ha ha!
Nngh… Still haven't found Komyoji!?
I-I'm terribly sorry. We've sent Androidmen out in every direction, but…

Spare me the excuses!

The secret of the special circuit remains unsolved, and Komyoji is still on the loose! You fool!
One moment… Lord Professor Gill.
Who's there!?

A pleasure to make your acquaintance.

I am Apfaron of the Battle Fleet Nation Naager, a weapons dealer who also trades in military strategy advice.

A business rival, then?

What have you come to sell to our DARK, which sells DARK Robots to countries all over the world?

Yes…

Today, as a token of our acquaintance, I have prepared a gift for you.

I am certain that you, Lord Professor Gill, will be most pleased with it…
Ugh, ughh…

Why, it's Komyoji!?

Heh heh heh… Apfaron, was it? I believe I'll buy those skills of yours…
You honor me greatly.

A pleasure to make your acquaintance.

I am Atefarina of the Battle Fleet Nation Naager, a weapons dealer who also trades in military strategy advice.

Yes…

Today, as a token of our acquaintance, I have prepared a gift for you.

I am certain that you, Lord Professor Gill, will be most pleased with it…

Why, it's Komyoji!?

Heh heh heh… Atefarina, was it? I believe I'll buy those skills of yours…
You honor me greatly.

A pleasure to make your acquaintance.

We are weapons dealers of the Battle Fleet Nation Naager who also trade in military strategy advice. I am Apfaron…
…and I am Atefarina.

Why, it's Komyoji!?

Heh heh heh… Apfaron, was it? I believe I'll buy those skills of yours…
Dr. Komyoji was returned to DARK by a deeply mysterious figure… The devilish Professor Gill secretly drew up a terrifying plan.
There was no way Jiro could know yet that it would be the most terrifying… and tragic plan of all for Kikaider, Jiro.
At that moment, the Pointer's horn sounded by Anne cut through Gill's flute! Jiro changes into Kikaider!
Defeat all of the space crime organization Makuu, the Shocker army and the DARK Destruction Squad, and rescue Dr. Komyoji!
The Pointer is destroyed or Anne Yuri is defeated
The Pointer is destroyed or Anne Yuri or Jiro is defeated
Lately, organizations threatening our Shocker's prestige, this DARK and Makuu and such, have been multiplying. How troublesome…

Ever since Takeshi Hongo escaped… our Shocker has suffered one blunder after another! So…

we will join forces with DARK and Makuu and sweep away the maggots, starting with Kamen Rider!!

To that end… DARK or Makuu, either will do! We can decide what to do with the other organizations afterward. Heh heh heh…

Doctor Death, Ambassador Hell!

Spider Man, Bat Man, Scorpion Man, Bee Woman… Every one of these cyborgs was defeated by Kamen Rider.

So our Shocker ran these cyborgs through the computer, selected only their strengths, and modified this: Gebacondor!

But Gebacondor has not yet awakened from its slumber. Gebacondor needs the fresh blood of young women!
This is strange. Lately… there's been a string of disappearances of young women.
Yeah… This is already the third one since the start of the month!
Still… that doesn't mean it's necessarily Shocker's doing, does it?

That's true…

I've heard that the behavior patterns of young Japanese women these days can't be predicted from analytical data.
Yeah… It might be one of those mini runaway trips that are trendy lately.
True, we can't say for sure in the current situation. But…
Shall we go take a look?
You two sure are worrywarts… But be careful!
Yeah…

Takeshi and Taki are the same as ever, eh?

But not me! I'm thinking of starting a new business. Hayato, what do you think?
What do I think? Oyassan, don't tell me… You're not planning to close Amigo…
Well, the shop… has pretty much turned into your headquarters. At this rate, ordinary customers won't come near the place, right?
Ha ha ha… You've got a point, Oyassan. So what are you going to do this time?

Let's see…

Maybe a racing club, my hobby, after all… or no, a sports shop for kids might be nice too…
Hee hee… That sounds fun, Mr. Tachibana.

Doesn't it?

Hey, Hayato… How about a photo studio, using your skills?
No way!? But then I won't be able to eat parfaits anymore!

Now, don't say that!

Hey, Hayato… How about a photo studio, using your skills?
No way! I don't take pictures of women.
It's around here, right? Where the disappearances happened…
All right, let's split up.
Taki, will you be all right on your own?

"Will I be all right?"

What do you mean, "will I be all right"? Leave it to me! I'll find something, I guarantee it!
Ha ha ha…
Suspicious… There's something in this whole area!
Ha ha ha ha… Exactly right, Takeshi Hongo!
Shocker!? Who are you?
I'd like you to remember the name Ambassador Hell, who has crossed all the way from Southeast Asia!
Ambassador Hell!?
Exactly… Said to be Shocker's top executive alongside Doctor Death.
Too bad, but as long as we're here, you won't get your way!!

Ha ha ha!

Takeshi Hongo… Taste the full might of our Shocker motorcycle corps, which operated in the shadows of Southeast Asia.
Rider… Henshin!!
Eeee! Fresh blood from young women.
Good… Drink your fill of this, and may you serve our Shocker well…

Gebacondor, rise! Rob humanity of its peace and devote yourself to Shocker's conquest of the world!

Now, test your destructive power! Go, Gebacondor!!
Fuyaeeh, fuyaeeh!!

Nngh… I admit I underestimated you somewhat.

But the contest has only just begun… Takeshi Hongo, no, Kamen Rider. Taki is crying in a certain building. Go and see!
What!? Taki is?
What!? Taki is?
Taki! Where are you? Taki!!
Rider, it's a time bomb! It's going to blow any second, get out of here!
You're Shocker's new monster, aren't you?

The time bomb will explode in five minutes!

Kamen Rider! Can you save Taki while fighting me? Fuyaeeh, fuyaeeh!!

uncertain: U01688/U01722: 失懸鏡き read as 失態続き ('one blunder after another')
U01694: 鬼に金棒 rendered 'an unbeatable combination'
U01712/U01713: one self-introduction split across two speakers (Apfaron then Atefarina); English split at the same point
U01714: Gill addresses only Apfaron by name, but お前たち (plural) kept as 'those skills of yours'
U01715: 立事 read as 立案 (drew up a plan)
U01742: Hayato refusing to photograph women; translated literally
U01761: 滝が泣いている kept literally ('Taki is crying')
